title: Back to NYU downtown and composition with Marion Bauer
summary: After Juilliard he took courses at NYU's downtown school and studied composition with Marion Bauer, again rejecting opinions as teaching.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: After leaving Copland, at that point you must have decided what you were going to do.
Right. I was still being poked by my family not to be a bum, to do
nothing, so then I tried Julliard but nothing happened there and then I went back--when I went to N.Y.U. originally for pre-med that was the uptown place; that's become Bronx Community College today.
When I went back I went to the downtown school, which is the only N.Y.U. that's left.
That's where I went and took a few courses there.

I studied composition there with Marion Bauer. She was a pretty decent composer herself, but once again, I like this, I don't like that; why didn't you go up there instead of down and it doesn't reach me, an approach like that. I don't want people's opinions.
These were, I assume, friendly conversations?
Right. She was a very nice person.
